result.summary: The page is mostly well-designed, but there is a critical localization bug where a raw translation key 'home_feed.popular_title' is displayed instead of a human-readable section title. A few minor cosmetic issues also exist.

issues.description: The section heading displays the raw i18n key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a translated, human-readable title (e.g. 'Popular near you'). This indicates a missing or failed localization string.
issues.suggestion: Add the proper translation for the 'home_feed.popular_title' key in the locale files and ensure the localization fallback resolves to a readable string rather than the raw key.

issues.description: The horizontal restaurant carousel under 'Fastest near you' cuts off the third card ('Trattoria Piccol...') at the right edge with no visual affordance (e.g. fade or partial-card hint is present but the title is truncated awkwardly).
issues.suggestion: Ensure truncated card titles use an ellipsis consistently and consider adding a subtle scroll indicator so users know more cards are available horizontally.

issues.description: The notification bell icon in the top-right has a red dot indicator but no visible label or badge count, which may be unclear to screen-reader users.
issues.suggestion: Add an accessible label (aria-label) describing the notification state, e.g. 'Notifications, 1 unread'.
